calendar: US stock market (NYSE + Nasdaq joint) calendar — dates the markets are CLOSED.
notes: US stock market (NYSE + Nasdaq joint) CLOSURE calendar, 2020-2026. Rules: fixed-date holidays falling on Saturday are observed the prior Friday and on Sunday the following Monday — EXCEPT New Year's Day on a Saturday, which is not observed at all (the prior Friday belongs to the previous year; e.g. no closure for Jan 1 2022). Juneteenth (Jun 19) has been a market holiday since 2022 only (2021 and earlier: not observed). Good Friday is a market holiday though not a US federal one. Special closure included: 2025-01-09, National Day of Mourning for President Carter. Half-day early closes (day after Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve / day before an observed holiday, e.g. 2026-07-02) are NOT closures and are excluded. Sources: NYSE official holiday calendar (nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars), NYSE Group 2020-2022 holiday announcement, NYSE 2022 yearly trading calendar — cross-checked against the historical NYSE closures list (joshuaulrich gist). Maintenance: extend each year when NYSE publishes the next year's schedule; special mourning closures are announced ad hoc — add them.
